title: Explosive runs and the Denver Broncos run game in 2025

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Explosive runs and the Denver Broncos run game in 2025
sources.description: Denver Broncos running backs had 23 explosive runs in 2025 on 329 carries. This was 7.0% of their carries which was about league average in 2025 (6.8%).
